test_evaluate: test the evaluate function to compute arithmetic expressions on left and right operands with optional numexpr acceleration
test_where: test the where function to evaluate a conditional expression returning left_op where cond is true and right_op otherwise
build_set_use_numexpr: build a configuration step that enables or disables numexpr acceleration for pandas expression evaluation
build_set_numexpr_threads: build a configuration step that sets the number of threads used by numexpr for parallel expression evaluation
test_set_test_mode: test the set_test_mode and get_test_result functions to track whether numexpr was used during evaluate calls
